title: Bulk archive tools you invoke, never prompted
acceptance: Multiple posts can be selected and archived in one action
Everything older than a chosen date can be archived in one action, with the count shown before it happens
Never-opened is available as a filter
Nothing counts, badges, or prompts: these surfaces appear only when the user goes looking for them
notes: Owner wants tools they reach for, not nagging — explicitly different in kind from T-0020, which was cut for speaking first. The distinction is the whole design constraint: invoked, never volunteered.

history.detail: was Cairn/Views/**; narrowed to the three files bulk actions and a never-opened filter need
